correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the source stabilization exactly: c is eventually representable after shifting by j precisely when c lies in the additive semigroup generated by n^k-1. The identity (2m)^k-1=(m^k-1)+m^k(2^k-1) reduces all even-base generators to A_k and odd-base generators. Because A_k is the sole odd generator in that presentation, parity of its multiplicity yields S_k=2T_k disjoint union (A_k+2T_k). T_k is cofinite because it contains the coprime pair A_k and (A_k^k-1)/2. The even and odd gaps then give the stated Frobenius and genus formulas without omitted boundary cases. The packaged regression checker reproduces the published k=2..9 table and the transfer formulas.
